name: Weakness
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, inquisitor 0, paladin 1, psychic 0, shaman 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, summoner/unchained summoner 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You inflict a minor curse on the target causing it to be more susceptible to harm, imposing a -1 penalty on saves.
